summary: The optional perf-cost check leaves pull requests and runs once a day as daily-perf-cost in the daily long lanes; Main upkeep still runs it on each push to main

compatibility.detail: perf-cost was never required and never ran in the merge queue; no required check or ruleset change. The quarantined messaging_faults::link_minutes case moves with it.

manual.detail: A red daily-perf-cost appears in the daily report and opens or comments on the one daily tracking issue.
